LOCAL MODIFICATION (GPU_and_PNM, 2026-10-24):
  src/fpu_div_sqrt_mvp/hdl/defs_div_sqrt_mvp.sv: Iteration_unit_num_S 2'b10 -> 2'b01 (original kept as .orig_79e4531).
  Reason: with 3 iteration units per cycle the div/sqrt iteration path misses 500 MHz at ASAP7 TT (placement STA -160..-170 ps);
  with 2 units it meets (+121 ps). Measured FP32 latency: DIV = SQRT = 15 cycles (issue interval 15); FMA 4, CMP 2, CVT 5 unchanged.
  Used identically by simulation (FPU_FPNEW) and synthesis.
